description:
For each free-text term, pick the best code FROM A VALUE SET YOU PROVIDE — the question "which code of this value set fits this field?".

Send `terms` (up to 50) and `value_set`: the allowed codes as `{ code, terminology }` pairs (up to 100; any of icd11, icd10, cid10, loinc, rxnorm, mesh, atc, icf, mixed if needed). Only those codes can be suggested — never a code outside the set.

How it works: every member is first confirmed at its source (the validate_codes logic), giving its official title and FHIR `coding`; members that do not exist or cannot be checked are listed in `value_set.unconfirmed` and never ranked. Then each term is scored against each confirmed member's title AND the synonyms its source publishes (ICD-11/ICF inclusions and index terms, LOINC related names, MeSH entry terms): `match_score` (lexical, 0-1), `match_type` (exact / strong / needs_review, the harmonize_terms rules) and `matched_label` (the synonym that scored, or null when the title did). Members sharing no word with the term are left out; a term with none left is `no_candidates`.

Lexical only: a synonym the source does NOT publish ("gait speed" for "walking speed") lands in needs_review or no_candidates — review those with a person. Each member is looked up live (cached), so a large set of ICD-11/ICF codes takes a few seconds.

When NOT to use: with no value set, map terms with harmonize_terms; to check a list of codes, use validate_codes.

max_candidates.description: Ranked members returned per term (1-10, default 3).

terms.description: Free-text terms to place in the value set (e.g. the field contents of your data). Up to 50.

value_set.description: The allowed codes, as code+terminology pairs (any of the validate_codes terminologies, mixed if needed). Only these codes can be suggested. Up to 100; each is confirmed at its source before ranking.

code.description: The code to validate (raw, as it appears in your data).

terminology.description: Which terminology this code belongs to. Required — auto-detection isn't supported because category-level codes like "A00" exist in both ICD-10 and CID-10.

name: match_value_set

attribution.description: Canonical source URLs of this response (attribution list)

counts.description: How many terms landed in each class (by their best member).

exact.description: Terms whose best member is an exact match.

needs_review.description: Terms whose best member needs review by a person.

no_candidates.description: Terms with no confirmed member sharing a word with them.

strong.description: Terms whose best member is a strong match.

provenance.description: One provenance block per upstream source that contributed to this response (licenses are never merged; each block carries the origin diagnostics of ITS source)

items.description: Bloco de proveniência: fonte, URL, competência, extração, diagnóstico de origem, citação e licença; e, só quando há o que dizer, de onde veio cada parte, avisos da fonte, o que o servidor calculou e se o dado ainda pode mudar

data_vintage.description: Version/release of the data as exposed by the source; null when not exposed

derivation_note.description: What this server computed; present together with derived

derived.description: Present (true) only when this server computed the value (e.g. a ranking or summary statistics) instead of passing on what the source returned

field_sources.description: Present only when the response joins parts from different origins or extraction instants: for each group of fields, its URL, extraction instant and whether it came from cache. Absent in single-origin responses

items.description: Proveniência de um grupo de campos da resposta: de onde veio e quando foi extraído

fields.description: Campos do payload atribuídos a esta sub-fonte

retrieved_at.description: ISO-8601 da extração desta sub-fonte na origem

served_from_cache.description: true se esta sub-fonte veio do cache do servidor (retrieved_at é o da extração original); false se foi buscada nesta chamada; null se o servidor não distingue

source_url.description: URL canônica da sub-fonte que originou estes campos

license.description: License / legal regime of the data

notices.description: Caveats the source publishes about the data, verbatim (license statements are not repeated here; see the info://licenses resource). Absent when there is none

anomalies.description: Anomalias superadas até o sucesso, somadas por classe, em ordem fixa; [] se nenhuma

kind.description: Classe da anomalia (vocabulário fechado do contrato)

attempts.description: Tentativas somadas, incluindo as repetidas (>= requests)

requests.description: Idas distintas à origem que compõem esta resposta (fatias, páginas)

unstable.description: true se houve repetição (attempts > requests) ou alguma anomalia

retrieval.description: Origin diagnostics of THIS source in this call: requests made to the upstream, attempts summed across retries, anomalies worked around (kind + count); unstable=true when any anomaly happened. null when nothing was measured (bundled dataset, or response served entirely from cache)

retrieved_at.description: Real instant of the upstream extraction (ISO-8601, UTC). Responses served from cache keep the ORIGINAL fetch instant.

revision.description: Whether the data can still change at the source: current = the version in force, the source may revise it; provisional = preliminary; final = will not change. Absent when unknown

note.description: O específico da fonte: o que revisa, quando, por quê

status.description: current = versão vigente, a fonte pode revisá-la; provisional = preliminar, incompleta ou sujeita a mudança (não compare como se fosse fechada); final = não muda mais, declarado pela fonte

source.description: Official upstream source of this data

source_url.description: Canonical URL of the source (API base or dataset release)

results.description: One entry per term, in request order.

anyOf.description: FHIR Coding for this code, ready to store in a FHIR resource.

code.description: The code in FHIR form. ICD-11: the entity id (e.g. "257068234"), per the HL7 terminology guide; the short code travels in `extension`. CID-10: DataSUS undotted form ("A001").

display.description: Official label from the source. Omitted when the source returned none.

extension.description: ICD-11 only: the short classification code beside the entity id. Omitted for groupings without a short code and for other terminologies.

system.description: Canonical FHIR system URI of the terminology (e.g. http://loinc.org).

version.description: Release this call read (ICD-11 release, CID-10 V2008). Omitted when the source does not state its release per answer (LOINC, RxNorm, MeSH, ATC via NLM services).

coding.description: FHIR Coding of the member (null only when the source gives no system for it).

match_score.description: Lexical similarity between the term and the title (0-1), computed by this server.

match_type.description: exact = same words; strong = every term word in the title (or the matched synonym) and score >= 0.85; needs_review = anything else.

matched_label.description: The synonym published by the source (ICD-11/ICF inclusion or index term, LOINC related name, MeSH entry term) that produced match_score, when it scored higher than the title; null when the title did.

title.description: Official title of the member, read at its source.

best.description: The best member for this term; null when status is no_candidates.

candidates.description: Ranked members (best first), at most max_candidates; members sharing no word with the term are left out.

coding.description: FHIR Coding of the member (null only when the source gives no system for it).

status.description: no_candidates = no confirmed member shares a word with the term.

value_set.description: What happened to the value set before ranking.

confirmed.description: Members confirmed at their source; only these are ranked.

submitted.description: Codes in the value set as sent.

unconfirmed.description: Members left out of the ranking, with why. Fix or drop them: an unconfirmed code is never suggested.

error.description: The failure message when reason is error; null otherwise.

reason.description: not_found = the source says the code does not exist; error = it could not be checked.

title: Match Terms to a Value Set
